_comment: Live edition check of EIA's Short-Term Energy Outlook (scripts/hyperscalers/check-steo.mjs, run by the automated job): the release and next-release dates printed on eia.gov/outlooks/steo. build-modules.mjs compares them with the curated card (power.json → grid → eia-steo-sales): a newer edition than the card's turns the card amber ("newer edition published"), and nextExpected follows the live date. Figures stay curated (T3, read from the published table).
